headword: {新規参入|しんきさんにゅう}

definitions.gloss: new market entry; entering a new market or industry
definitions.explanation: When a company or individual enters an industry, market, or field for the first time. A key concept in business strategy and economics.

examples.japanese: ⟦{大手|おおて}→大手：12171_oote⟧IT⟦{企業|きぎょう}→企業：00225_kigyou⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{金融|きんゆう}→金融：02664_kinyuu⟧⟦{業界|ぎょうかい}→業界：13129_gyoukai⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{新規参入|しんきさんにゅう}⟦した→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: A major IT company entered the financial industry.

examples.japanese: {新規参入|しんきさんにゅう}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{阻|はば}む→阻む：14529_habamu⟧⟦{規制|きせい}→規制：02598_kisei⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{多|おお}い→多い：01127_ooi⟧。
examples.english: There are many regulations that prevent new market entry.

examples.japanese: {新規参入|しんきさんにゅう}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{相次|あいつ}いだ→相次ぐ：14869_aitsugu⟧こと⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{競争|きょうそう}→競争：01388_kyousou⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{激|はげ}しく→激しい：02348_hageshii⟧⟦なり→なる：01970_naru⟧、⟦{消費者|しょうひしゃ}→消費者：09866_shouhisha⟧⟦にとって→にとって：06803_nitotte⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{価格|かかく}→価格：00147_kakaku⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{下|さ}がる→下がる：01188_sagaru⟧⟦メリット→メリット：06848_meritto⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧。
examples.english: As new entrants continued to appear, competition intensified, which has the benefit of lower prices for consumers.

notes:
USAGE:
A standard business and economics term frequently used in news, business reports, and strategy discussions. Deregulation ({規制緩和|きせいかんわ}) often leads to increased new market entry.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {新規参入|しんきさんにゅう}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧ (to enter a new market)
- {新規参入|しんきさんにゅう}⟦{企業|きぎょう}→企業：00225_kigyou⟧ (new entrant company)
- {新規参入|しんきさんにゅう}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{促|うなが}す→促す：10875_unagasu⟧ (to encourage new market entry)
- {新規参入|しんきさんにゅう}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{障壁|しょうへき}→障壁：14536_shouheki⟧ (barriers to entry)
